traps.description: notification-svc v3.3.0 bumped its queue client 3 minutes before lag started, which looks like a bad deploy; but the logs from 02:14 to 02:58 were dropped, so nothing shows the new client failing, and recovery came from a consumer rebalance, not a rollback
Lowering queue-broker's consumer.max_inflight, with a matching past incident, looks like a config cause; but the setting was never reverted and delivery recovered anyway
A single 429 from the push provider and a past incident about provider throttling suggest a third-party limit; it was one retried batch, and send rate was low because the queue was not being consumed
